title: Aether pet catalog
description: What the game's records do not say about pets: their names and genera, and the souls each level takes. Names and genera come from taengu's Pet Soul Tracker (bun run sync:pets). Bump `revision` on every change.

soulsPerLevel.description: Souls from level 0 to 1, 1 to 2, and so on. Its length is the highest level souls reach.

genera.description: Genus id -> its name in each language, as the game shows it.

id.description: The pet's id in the game's records (Aether shows it under a pet with no name).

special.description: Comes at its highest level and takes no souls.

unreleased.description: Its souls only drop on maps not open yet; listed once the player has some.
